title: Gaussian law of a unit projection
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n\in\mathbb R^n$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$. The map $z\mapsto\sum_{i=1}^n a_i z_i$ sends the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures on $\mathbb R$ to the standard Gaussian measure.
replaced: For every $a\in\mathbb R^n$ with $\sum_i a_i^2=1$, the map $z\mapsto\sum_i a_i z_i$ pushes standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$ to $N(0,1)$.
